motion_rule: he rides a depot loading belt racing at the lens, the camera racing backwards ahead so the parcel stacks tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; the belt carries him through every beat and he never works a prop standing; head half the frame, from 6.3 a low angle, head low; new shot size each beat, one action per beat, camera move every beat; the picture fills the vertical frame top to bottom with no bars
character: a small sand-coloured fennec with huge ears, deadpan
second_characters: ONE scrawny jerboa runner sprinting the belt beside him, catching every falling nugget out of the air before it can reach his paws
props: ONE plain cardboard box with a fat golden mountain stamped on its side, riding the belt at his knee
prop_continuity: the box stays plain and empty to the end however much gold pours past; the tape he rips off at 2.9 never goes back on
environment: an open desert parcel depot at noon, parcel stacks to the roof both sides, dunes beyond the wire fence, the belt racing under
light_events: hard noon sun through the stack gaps bars his ears every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: ko-ROB-ka, o-be-SHCHA-la, zo-lo-TY-ye, GO-ry, KA-zhet-sya, GDE-to, za ug-LOM
audio.pacing: 0.4-3.5 one breath; the gap under one second; 4.4-7.0 one breath with no voice sound outside the lines; after 7.0 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: the belt humming, the depot roaring, tape ripping at 2.9, a far-off rumble from 4.4, gold hammering the parcel stacks from 7.0

timeline.a: he rides the belt at the lens, the stamped box rocking at his knee, stacks tearing past
he hooks a claw under the tape without slowing
he tips the stamped side of the box up to the lens as the belt hauls him along
the jerboa swings in at the box and is carried on past it
he rips the tape and throws the flaps wide, the box plain and empty inside
he shakes the open box at the lens and nothing at all comes out of it
gold bursts out of the dunes far beyond the fence, never out of the box
he rears up on the belt, ears swivelling after the rumble
the gold fall runs off down the dunes away from him, the jerboa tearing after it
he digs at the sand blowing over the belt and comes up with a pawful of grit
the fall jumps the fence and hammers the parcel stacks the whole lane long, none of it near him
he holds the open box up into the falling gold and every nugget skips off the flaps
the jerboa hauls a fistful past his nose and he grabs at it and misses
he throws himself into the lens, deadpan, the empty box on his head, gold pouring past behind

must_appear: one plain box with a stamped golden mountain; at 2.9 the open box is empty; from 4.4 the gold bursts out of the dunes beyond the fence, never out of the box; at 7.8 nothing lands in the box he holds up; at 9.3 his deadpan face is in the lens, the empty box on his head
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal bars, a 16:9 frame, night, dark scene, standing bystanders, a still background, a parked camera, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, gold coming out of the box, gold landing in the box, a word not in the lines, a drawn-out word, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
